title: Climb the return pipe
story: Mica is below the rail switch. Lift the filter cartridge vertically, then traverse the top service rail.
lesson: Break a plan into two lists of moves. Use abs for distance and choose a direction from the sign.
objective: Return UP to reach row zero, then LEFT or RIGHT to the goal. Coordinates are [x,y].
sample: start=[1,2], goal=[3,0] -> UP, UP, RIGHT, RIGHT
hint: Start with ['UP'] * start[1]. Use goal[0] - start[0] for the horizontal leg.
